description:
CloudMindMaps turns anything you're discussing in ChatGPT into a clear, interactive mind map. Ask it to map meeting notes, a report, a reading list, a project plan, or just a topic — CloudMindMaps structures the ideas and returns a live map with an inline preview, right in the chat.

Every map opens at cloudmindmaps.app as a free, browser-based, editable and shareable diagram, and uses the open FreeMind/Freeplane .mm format, so it also opens in those desktop apps.

What you can do:
• "Turn these notes into a mind map"
• "Make a mind map of the pros and cons of X"
• "List my mind maps and open the roadmap one"

Sign in once with your CloudMindMaps account; maps you create are saved there.

defaultPrompt: Turn these notes into a mind map: Launch plan- Marketing (social, email), Product (beta, GA), Ops. Make a mind map.
Make a mind map of the pros and cons of remote work
